title: A full test run fits its darwin limit again: tests spread one at a time over the workers
goal: tests.py hands the suite's tests to its workers one at a time, so no module or class scope bounds a full run's wall time; the land and brief tests that build a cold rag index only to read a brief line no longer build one; a full tests.py run on a quiet darwin host takes at most 27 s with no test id lost
